scientific_integrity: Proof and executable finite spot checks are supplied. Finite checks do not certify infinite-time asymptotics. No authorship or external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Not an invariant-induced-measure tail, not a theorem for all asymmetric systems; fixed exponent only; unindexed parabolic iteration expansions may overlap.
scientific_scope: An exact conditional Lebesgue first-return tail and its subleading logarithmic and constant terms for a symmetric full-branch intermittent interval-map family, 0<ell<1.
title: Exact return tails and an exponent-determined logarithmic correction for a doubly intermittent map
